decisions: What is the current state of Multimodal LLMs according to this review? Summarize the key trends.

requirements.description: Must reference the 'Taxonomy' or 'Timeline' figure to illustrate the rapid evolution of models (e.g., LLaVA, BLIP, Flamingo).
Must classify models based on their 'Connector' modules (e.g., Projection vs. Q-Former) as a primary categorization method.
Must list the supported modalities beyond image-text, specifically mentioning Audio and Video integration capabilities.
Must mention the challenges in evaluating these models, such as the reliance on specific benchmarks (POPE, MME) versus human eval.
